resources.string: Confirm it’s you to open your locked notes
Its pages are encrypted on this device. Unlock with your fingerprint, face, screen lock or app PIN.
Its pages are encrypted on this device. Opening it will need your fingerprint, face or screen lock.

This device has no screen lock, so BestNote uses an app PIN instead. Its pages are encrypted on this device and opening it will need the PIN. The PIN is set once and only a scrambled check of it is kept.
While locked, it shows a lock instead of its pages and is left out of search, Continue writing and Recent.

Important: if you remove or reset your screen lock (or clear the app PIN by clearing app data), Android may delete the key that opens locked notebooks, and they cannot be opened any more. A recovery password lets you open them anyway. Keep it somewhere safe: BestNote cannot reset it.
Enter the PIN you set for locked notebooks.
This device’s key can no longer open this notebook, usually because the screen lock was removed or changed. Enter the recovery password you set when you locked it.
BestNote couldn’t change the lock. Your notebook was not changed; try again.
The key that opened this notebook is gone (the screen lock was removed or reset) and no recovery password was set, so it cannot be decrypted.
The notebook will be stored unencrypted again and will show its pages, appear in search and be backed up like any other.
This notebook is locked, but the exported file is not encrypted: anyone who gets the file can read it.
